description: A full-stack Nuxt 3 web app styled with Tailwind CSS. Pages render ahead of the browser for fast first loads, and each file in the pages folder becomes a route.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. a blog, an e-commerce storefront, a business app with SSR
ui.description: Nuxt 3 + Tailwind. Server-side rendered Vue 3 app with file-based routing and API routes.

sample_prompts: A recipe sharing site with categories, search, and detailed recipe pages
A real estate listing portal with property cards and filter sidebar
A team directory app with employee profiles and department views
